cues: Seven point four grams of ether is zero point one mole.
Iodoethane has molar mass one hundred fifty five point nine.
Hot and excess: two moles of iodoethane per mole of ether, so thirty one point two grams, plus one point eight grams of water.
Cold, with only one mole of H I per mole: four point six grams of ethanol and fifteen point six grams of iodoethane.
